# archgram

> archgram draws software architecture diagrams from a JSON or YAML spec: it lays out the nodes, routes the edges around the boxes and writes one self-contained SVG, in light and dark, with the flows the spec names animated. It runs as a native command (`npx archgram`), and its `archgram` skill lets a coding agent draw a project's architecture from its code.

- Install: `npm install --save-dev archgram`; draw: `npx archgram build <spec>`; check: `npx archgram check <spec>`; print the spec format: `npx archgram spec`.
- The output needs no script, server or web font, and the same spec gives the same bytes on every machine.
- License: MIT.
